( #{item.atcId}, LEFT(#{item.lstPlace}, 100), LEFT(#{item.lstNm}, 100), LEFT(#{item.fdPrdtNm}, 100), STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{item.lstYmd}, '-', ''), '%Y%m%d'),

mapper.select: SELECT num, atc_id AS atcId, id, lst_place AS lstPlace, lst_prdt_num AS lstPrdtNum, lst_sbjt AS lstSbjt, lst_ymd AS lstYmd, prdt_cl_num AS prdtClNum, created, updated, done, deleted FROM lost_police WHERE atc_id = #{atcId}

SELECT num, atc_id AS atcId, id, lst_place AS lstPlace, lst_prdt_num AS lstPrdtNum, lst_sbjt AS lstSbjt, lst_ymd AS lstYmd, prdt_cl_num AS prdtClNum, created, updated, done, deleted FROM lost_police ORDER BY num DESC
